records.title: Accelerating Deep Learning Inference for Brain Tumor Segmentation: A Review of Architectures, Frameworks, and Clinical Translation
records.reason: 本文はbrain-tumor segmentation向けにquantization, pruning, compiled runtime, hardware-aware inferenceを整理するreview。推論効率の評価設計は隣接するが、医療vision固有の整理でLLM servingへの直接的な結果はなく、転用可能性は限定的。

records.title: Learning Permutation Distributions via Reflected Diffusion on Ranks
records.reason: 本文はpermutation空間上のprobability distributionを学ぶdiffusion手法で、attention/KV cacheやLLM inference runtimeの改善を扱わない。

records.title: vAccSOL: Efficient and Transparent AI Vision Offloading for Mobile Robots
records.reason: 本文はmobile robot vision workloadをedge/cloud間でoffloadし、透明性とresource制約を扱う。offloadingはserving lineageに隣接する一方、LLMではなく視覚推論固有の結果である。

records.title: Are a Thousand Words Better Than a Single Picture? Beyond Images - A Framework for Multi-modal Knowledge Graph Dataset Enrichment
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨を確認。Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs (MMKGs) benefit from visual information, yet large-scale image collection is hard to curate and often excludes ambiguous but relevant visuals (e.g., logos, symbols, abstract scenes). We present Beyond Images, an automatic data-centric enrichment pipeline with optional human auditing.
